def ensure_default_roles():
    for name in ["ADMINISTRADOR", "VENDEDOR", "AUDITOR", "JEFE_ALMACEN"]:

[documentos]
def build_dashboard_options(role_name: str | None):
    """

    :param role_name: indicates the name of the role provide.
    :return: a list of options to depend on the role.
    """
    if role_name == "ADMINISTRADOR":
        return _opts_admin()
    if role_name == "VENDEDOR":
        return _opts_vendedor()
    if role_name == "AUDITOR":
        return _opts_auditor()
    if role_name == "JEFE_ALMACEN":
        return _opts_jefe_almacen()
    return [{"titulo": "Perfil", "url": "profile",
             "icono": "M15 9.75a3 3 0 1 1-6 0 3 3 0 0 1 6 0z"}]





[documentos]
@login_required(login_url="login")
def dashboard(request):
    """
    Displays all options for a dashboard
    :param request: HTTP object method
    :return: A list of options to depend on the role.
    """
    ensure_default_roles()
    role = request.user.groups.first()
    opts = build_dashboard_options(role.name if role else None)
    return render(request, "dashboard/index.html", {"options": opts})
